integration_issues.flow: Waivers My Claims tab — Cancel button visibility
integration_issues.issue: Tab header shows 'My Claims (38)' and the list renders 38 rows, but ZERO Cancel buttons render (data-testid='waiver-claim-cancel-{id}' count=0). Code at /app/frontend/src/lovable/pages/Waivers.tsx:590 only renders Cancel when claim.status === 'pending'. Data inspection needed — likely the local claim.status string is not exactly 'pending' (could be capitalised, or backend returns 'Pending'/'PENDING'/'open'). Without a Cancel button, feature #3b (cancel hits DELETE /api/waivers/claims/{id}) cannot be exercised by users. Should normalise status comparison: claim.status?.toLowerCase() === 'pending'.

integration_issues.flow: Waivers — Claim modal precheck drop picker
integration_issues.issue: Clicked 'Claim' on an Available player while Ice Kings team is in Illegal (23/19 roster) state expected to trigger precheck.requires_drop=true. Modal did not open with [data-testid='precheck-drop-picker'] or [data-testid='precheck-drop-select'] visible in DOM (both count=0). Either (a) modal did not open at all on click, or (b) precheck didn't return requires_drop, or (c) the picker testid is only present on a sub-step that wasn't reached. Could not verify feature #6 end-to-end.

action_items: Normalise claim.status comparison in Waivers.tsx ~L590 to case-insensitive (e.g., String(claim.status).toLowerCase() === 'pending') OR confirm the backend payload uses the exact 'pending' literal. Without this, the Cancel button never renders and feature #3b regresses for users with pending claims.

Manually exercise the precheck-drop-picker by clicking Claim while team is full — confirm the modal renders the testid and DELETE call fires when proceeding through the drop flow. Optional: add a Playwright deep-path test that opens the claim modal, asserts precheck-drop-select options match user's roster.

(Optional regression guard) Add a Playwright test that pins iter180 fix: PUT a known position_breakdown.active and assert exact slot label counts in DOM (C, LW, RW, D occurrences) on /team — caught the iter95 regression manually.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayerRoster.tsx is now 2900+ lines and still growing — split into focused modules (slot-rendering, section-config, lineup-validation, drag-drop, mock-data helpers, sub-tables). The RosterConfigContext workaround is elegant but only papers over the architectural issue of huge file with multiple module-scope components.

useRosterConfig hook fallback (line 208) silently returns the module default LEAGUE_ROSTER_SLOTS when no provider is mounted. Add a console.warn in dev mode so a missing provider is loud (would have caught iter95 regression earlier).
Waivers.tsx claim.status equality check is a brittle exact-string compare; consider a Set/enum or lowercased comparison to avoid silent UI regressions when the backend payload shape changes.
